skill.displayName: Remove Filter from Photo Online – AI Filter Remover for Natural Image Restoration – API-powered
skill.summary: AI filter remover — remove photo filters and restore natural image colors

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of remove-filter-from-photo-openapi-skill.
- Removes filters from photos and restores natural image colors via WeShop OpenAPI.
- Secure API key management with strong warnings: only send your API key to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Supports uploading images, describing filters to remove, and batch processing (up to 16 images).
- Provides clear endpoint documentation and usage instructions.
